releases.name: Version 0.4.0
releases.body:
Improved Ship Log and Signal Editing

- You can now learn a specific ship log fact instead of all of them
- You can now learn *only* base-game signals/frequencies
- You can now learn *only* base-game ship log facts

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Bwc9876/OW-SaveEditor/compare/0.3.0...0.4.0
releases.bodyZh:
改进飞船日志和信号编辑

- 你现在可以学习特定的飞船日志事实，而不是全部
- 你现在可以学习*仅*基础游戏的信号/频率
- 你现在可以学习*仅*基础游戏的飞船日志事实

**完整变更日志**: https://github.com/Bwc9876/OW-SaveEditor/compare/0.3.0...0.4.0
